# FAME Protocol

> One curve. No insiders. Formally verified parametric parlay infrastructure: two-leg structured trades with on-chain liquidity ratios, a hard emission cap and slot-level settlement proofs.

This site ships markdown mirrors of every indexable page so research agents can read the canonical content without rendering JavaScript. Figures marked illustrative are deterministic design parameters — verify from primary sources (program accounts, public invariant repository).

## Pages

- [Home](https://sambacha.github.io/fame-beta-site/fame-beta-site/): landing page — protocol stability anchor, problem/solution narrative, parametric order flow, request access.
- [Liquidity Ratios & Emission Caps: Inside FAME's Risk Engine](https://sambacha.github.io/fame-beta-site/fame-beta-site/journal/liquidity-ratios-emission-caps): How the FAME Protocol computes liquid backing per slot, why the 1,000,000,000 FAME emission cap is an immutable constant rather than a vote, and a five-step institutional due-diligence checklist for fair-launch DeFi.
- [Formal Verification Is DeFi's Missing Safety Layer | FAME Protocol](https://sambacha.github.io/fame-beta-site/fame-beta-site/journal/formal-verification-defi-safety): Why audits sample code while formal verification proves it: the invariants FAME machine-checks on every deploy, the honest limits of verified DeFi, and the five questions to ask any protocol claiming mathematical guarantees.
